description: Bible study with cross-references and Strong's — fully offline StudyBible — a cross-platform app for Bible reading and study. Everything works offline: no accounts, no telemetry, no cloud. Bundled content: Synodal Russian Bible (1876), KJV 1769 with Strong's numbers, and OpenBible cross-references — ready out of the box. Features: • Reading and study modes • Translation comparison • Interlinear and Strong's lexicon • Cross-references • Notes, bookmarks, highlights • Text-to-speech (system voices) • Import of .sb/.sbz modules Additional translations and reference works are imported as modules. Each module carries its own license and attribution, shown in the app. Rust core, Flutter UI. MIT OR Apache-2.0.
